tools.name: extension_submit_read
tools.description: Read a project's store state through extension.dev: preflight answers what each store still needs, status the submissions. extension_submit_check asks approvals and extension_submit runs them.
tools.gate: the server started with --features=local,platform, and a login; dryRun: false, cancel, rollout, release, publish, sync-listing and configure-store need a workspace owner's approval
tools.samplePrompt: Is my extension ready for the Chrome Web Store?

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: preflight: what each store still needs; status: each store's word on the submissions.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: '<workspace>/<project>' login to use when several are stored.

inputs.name: browsers
inputs.description: The stores to read.

inputs.name: buildSha
inputs.description: Commit sha of a completed platform build (extension_builds_read).

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Label; default the built manifest's version.

inputs.name: detail
inputs.description: preflight: true, or ["chrome", "safari.subtitle"], answers those rows in full.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: Base URL; omitted: EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL, else extension.dev.

tools.name: extension_templates
tools.description: Browse the template catalog or read a template's files. Answers slugs with surfaces and framework, or file contents; extension_create makes a project from one, extension_add_feature plans a surface in an existing project, extension_project_create puts a folder on extension.dev. Slugs: 'javascript' (plain), 'typescript', shadcn 'sidebar-shadcn'; AI templates tag 'ai'.
tools.gate: none
tools.samplePrompt: Which templates have a side panel? Show me the source of the best one

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: list searches; source reads one template's files.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: source: the template, e.g. 'content-react'.

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: source: paths to read; omit for the listing.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: list: keywords or a natural phrase.

inputs.name: surface
inputs.description: list: surface; for a popup use query:'action'.

inputs.name: framework
inputs.description: list: UI framework; empty string is vanilla.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: list: tags, e.g. ['ai'].

inputs.name: featured
inputs.description: list: featured only.

inputs.name: include
inputs.description: list: details adds tags, difficulty, featured, useCases; urls adds repositoryUrl, catalogUrl, downloads.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: list: a cut answer's nextOffset.

tools.name: extension_theme_verify
tools.description: Verify a Chrome theme manifest, not an extension's: the colors Chrome paints and the keys it drops. Answers the resolved colors, the discarded keys and the checks left for a person in a browser; extension_manifest_validate covers extension manifests. Static: no browser runs.
tools.gate: the server started with extras in --features, as in --features=local,platform,extras
tools.samplePrompt: Does this theme manifest paint the colors it declares?

inputs.name: manifest
inputs.description: Theme manifest object; or manifestPath.

inputs.name: manifestPath
inputs.description: Path to a theme manifest.json.

tools.name: extension_try
tools.description: Run a published extension.dev build in a fresh profile on this machine, no install, and screenshot it. Answers the opened page, its screenshot and the sites and permissions the extension can reach; extension_dev runs a local project. action:'close' ends it. Safari is refused.
tools.gate: the server started with --features=local,platform; a public project needs no login, a private one a login for it
tools.samplePrompt: Try cezaraugusto/rebeccat for me and show me what it does

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Published "<workspace>/<project>".

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Version or build sha; default newest.

inputs.name: browser
inputs.description: chrome, edge or firefox; safari is refused.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: http(s) page to open.

inputs.name: headless
inputs.description: false opens a usable window.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: run launches; close ends this project's tries.

inputs.name: idleMinutes
inputs.description: Idle minutes before it ends itself; 0 never; default 30.

tools.name: extension_wait
tools.description: Wait for a session to be ready, or for: "rebuild" for the next compile after an edit. Needed only after wait:false, a ready.status not "ready", or noBrowser from extension_dev or extension_start. Answers port, controlPort and the browser debugging port (cdpPort or rdpPort). extension_reload forces a reload, extension_open shows a surface, extension_stop ends the session.
tools.gate: the server started with extras in --features, as in --features=local,platform,extras; a live dev or start session
tools.samplePrompt: Wait until the dev session is ready, then tell me the ports

inputs.name: projectPath
inputs.description: The extension's folder (manifest.json or package.json).

inputs.name: browser
inputs.description: Running session's browser; needed when several run.

inputs.name: timeoutMs
inputs.description: Wait budget in ms, clamped 1000-50000; on starting, call again.

inputs.name: timeout
inputs.description: Deprecated alias of timeoutMs.

inputs.name: for
inputs.description: rebuild: the next compile and reload after an edit.

inputs.name: since
inputs.description: rebuild: ISO time a compile must follow.

tools.name: extension_workspace_configure
tools.description: Change a project's settings, visibility or build environment on extension.dev. configure-project renames a project (displayName; slug and URLs stay). set-visibility public or a public liveChannel needs approval. Answers what changed; extension_workspace_read reads.
tools.gate: the server started with --features=local,platform, and a login of any project in the workspace; settings and set-visibility need that project's own login; a public visibility needs a workspace owner's approval
tools.samplePrompt: Make the newtab project public

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: configure-project: project fields; set-visibility: private or public; set-environment: build variables.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.description: private: plain call under the owner's own token; public: approve page.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: configure-project: changed fields only (displayName, description, url, supportUrl, branch, rootDirectory, workspaceRoot, buildPullRequests, runWhatsNew, runExtensionExecutables, pullRequestComments, commitComments, autoCreateGitHubRelease, liveChannel); displayName renames the project.

inputs.name: variables
inputs.description: set-environment: build variables to add or change.

inputs.name: remove
inputs.description: set-environment: build variables to delete.

inputs.name: approvalId
inputs.description: For set-visibility public.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: Slug.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Stored login; the project to change.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: Base URL; omitted: EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL, else extension.dev.

tools.name: extension_workspace_create
tools.description: Create a missing extension.dev workspace, before extension_project_create; the personal workspace always exists. The first call answers a code and URL, and whoever approves becomes its owner; a second call with deviceCode finishes it.
tools.gate: the server started with --features=local,platform
tools.samplePrompt: Create a workspace called acme on extension.dev

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: New slug (lowercase, digits, hyphens); your personal one exists.

inputs.name: displayName
inputs.description: Human name (default the slug).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Short description.

inputs.name: developerUrl
inputs.description: Public URL.

inputs.name: deviceCode
inputs.description: Resume token.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: Base URL; omitted: EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL, else extension.dev.

tools.name: extension_workspace_read
tools.description: Read the extension.dev workspace: info, projects, usage and settings. Answers the sections asked; extension_workspace_configure changes settings, visibility and environment.
tools.gate: the server started with --features=local,platform, and a login of any project in the workspace; settings and set-visibility need that project's own login; a public visibility needs a workspace owner's approval
tools.samplePrompt: How many builds has my workspace used this month, and which projects failed their last build?

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: info, projects, usage or settings: the section to answer.

inputs.name: include
inputs.description: Extra read-only sections to answer with the workspace.

inputs.name: workspace
inputs.description: Slug.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Stored login; for settings, the project.

inputs.name: api
inputs.description: Base URL; omitted: EXTENSION_DEV_API_URL, else extension.dev.
